ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupying the central 80% of both lobes; dark black peripheral mapping along the peduncle junction and distal tips; localized dark focal spots (approx. 5-10 pixel diameter) clustered near the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; approximately 12 primary peaks on the left lobe and 14 on the right lobe; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude varies from 2 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge; trailing edge is generally straight with a slight upward curvature toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of high-contrast white circular spots on the far distal tip of the left lobe (pixels 100-150 on the horizontal axis of the tip).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear streaks on the mid-left lobe, oriented diagonally; one horizontal linear disruption above the peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant horizontal linear scar across the lower central fluke; irregular notch at the apex of the right lobe suggesting historic tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'semicolon' shaped dark pigment marking located immediately to the right of the median notch cleft.
